Market Entry Strategy

**Last published date:** 2026-03-13

The best way to gain firsthand experience in Slovakia is to visit. Make the U.S. Commercial Service Bratislava office your first stop when considering entry to the Slovak market. You can get a feeling for what the market is like and how your product or service would be received. Bratislava is a 45-minute drive from Vienna airport.  
After a visit to Slovakia, you may want to consider other regional markets that border Slovakia, including Czechia, Poland, Hungary, Austria, and Ukraine. Slovakia is an EU member and can serve as a gateway to the 27-member EU market.

The most common and simple option for establishing an office in Slovakia is to create a limited liability company (LLC).
